settings.name: Sofia Marinotti
settings.headline: Quiet process, loud results.
settings.text: No drama, no over-promising — just steady, honest work. Progress is a launch, not a finish line. And when it lands, it lands well.

settings.name: Marco Fenelli
settings.headline: Craft you can feel in the details.
settings.text: Every corner of the work reveals a second look. Our customers may not articulate why it feels considered, but the numbers say they notice.

settings.name: Alba Moretti
settings.headline: They pushed back, and they were right.
settings.text: Things felt off-line at times, and we voiced that more than once. Both times we were heard — and both times we ended a week later, better.
